The '''Porpor system''' was located in the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Porporite]]s,<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> which was [[Speciecide|exterminated]] by [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in [[4800 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Porpor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square S-16.<ref name="TEA" />
